race.description: Bottle-O Xmas Races Friday 20th November Book Now Hcp (Bm62)
race.comment: NEZIHA (9) is the horse to beat after resuming with a determined neck win at Pakenham Synthetic, where she overcame an awkward start and finished best from midfield. Her profile is still lightly raced, she's in the right camp and draws for every chance. BAGANOV (5) has been building well with two thirds this campaign, the latest in a Class 1 at Tatura when run down late after being well-supported favourite, and the return to a suitable 1300m keeps him right in the race. MR BUTT'S BOATS (11) has not fired at his past two, but his record at this venue is strong and he should get a good run near the pace for Meech. TWO TO TANGO (12) was below market expectations behind NEZIHA first-up, though her BM78 run before a spell gives her some depth and she can sharpen second-up.
